name: us2-team-managed-discovery
description: Team-managed (next-gen) project discovery: project-owned objects, Epic/Sub-task hierarchy only, and the project's own estimation field ranked (never the global Story Points, research §3). Both ports must produce a byte-identical binding, exit code, and Jira API call sequence (NFR-1). Discovery parity is asserted directly in tests/bash/sink/test_discovery_team.bats; this golden scenario is wired end-to-end through the config command in US1. The fixture is repo-with-two-styles because the project the mock provisions as team-managed has to be one the committed config both declares and declares as team_managed: routed against a fixture declaring only a company_managed COMP, this scenario discovered COMP as company_managed and never called TEAM at all, proving nothing about team-managed discovery. Resolving both styles in one run also pins the two discovery paths against each other.
